description: Issue #953 (adversarial review of #947) finding F4: the #947 fix's own commit narrative claims GetExportExcel/GetExportExcelStream (-> CheckExport -> GetCheckedExportQuery() -> GetBatchQuery()) were also closed by rewiring GetBatchQuery()'s default (no explicit ReplaceWhere) branch to call the new GetAuthorizedIdsQuery instead of the old WhereReplaceModifier-based rebuild -- but the only test #947 shipped (SelectorDataPrivilegeTests947.Selector_...) drives Selector, which at the time reached GetAuthorizedIdsQuery via a separate PopulateSelectedEntities call, not via GetBatchQuery()'s default branch. Reverting GetBatchQuery()'s default branch back to the WhereReplaceModifier rebuild left the entire test suite green -- the GetExportExcel/GetExportExcelStream half of the fix shipped unproven, violating #834's own rule that every claimed-fixed sink needs its own red/green proof. This mutant reverts BasePagedListVM.cs's GetBatchQuery() method body back to the exact pre-#947 shape: GetSearchQuery() is called unconditionally up front into a local baseQuery, and when ReplaceWhere is null, a WhereReplaceModifier is built from the Ids-Contains expression and applied to baseQuery.Expression via the query provider -- deleting every Where node in GetSearchQuery(), DataPrivilege included, before rebuilding with only the Ids restriction. The new GetExportExcel_... test (added by the same #953 review pass) seeds two Schools and one Major per School, restricts an admin caller's DataPrivilege grant to only the allowed School, POSTs both Majors' ids to /_Framework/GetExportExcel, and parses the returned .xlsx with NPOI. With the mutant applied, DataPrivilege is stripped and the forbidden Major's name appears in the exported workbook, turning the negative assertion red; on the unmutated (fixed) tree it does not. Because F2 also routes Selector through this same GetBatchQuery() default branch, this mutant incidentally also turns SelectorDataPrivilegeTests947.Selector_... red -- red_test_filter below is scoped to GetExportExcel_... only, so it is proven independently of the Selector test (see mutant 947-selector-populateselectedentities-replacewhere-reintroduce for that half).
target_symbol: BasePagedListVM<TModel,TSearcher>.GetBatchQuery()'s method body -- reverted from the GetAuthorizedIdsQuery-based rewrite back to the pre-#947 WhereReplaceModifier-based rebuild (GetSearchQuery() called unconditionally into a local baseQuery; when ReplaceWhere is null, WhereReplaceModifier(tmpIds.GetContainIdExpression(peid)) is applied to baseQuery.Expression via baseQuery.Provider.CreateQuery; the else branch returns baseQuery instead of a fresh GetSearchQuery() call)

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.SelectorDataPri: #953 F4: a DataPrivilege-restricted caller must not receive a row

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured verbatim against the committed baseline (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first; mutant patch applied via `git apply`, test run, then reverted via `git apply -R`): GetExportExcel_DataPrivilegeRestrictedCaller_Ids_ExcludesUnauthorized_IncludesAuthorized -- 'Assert.IsFalse failed. #953 F4: a DataPrivilege-restricted caller must not receive a row (forbiddenMajor, belonging to a school outside their DataPrivilege grant) in an Excel export they named directly in the Ids they posted to GetExportExcel -- GetBatchQuery()'s default branch must keep row-level DataPrivilege intact via GetAuthorizedIdsQuery, the same mechanism Selector relies on.' -- the forbidden Major's name appeared in the exported workbook, exactly reproducing the pre-#947 DataPrivilege bypass through the export path. Also manually confirmed this mutant turns SelectorDataPrivilegeTests947.Selector_... red too (2 failed when both tests run together against the mutated tree; the green control RequestBindingScopeHttpTests867.Configs_EnforceRequestBindingScope_DefaultsToTrue still passed, 1 passed) -- consistent with F2's finding that both tests now depend on the same GetBatchQuery() mechanism; red_test_filter is scoped to GetExportExcel_... alone so this mutant's own dotnet test --filter invocation never includes Selector_.... Manual dotnet test run of the mutated tree scoped to GetExportExcel_... alone: 1 failed (the test above); the mutated tree still builds cleanly (0 errors).
